services.name: Judo
services.desc: Absolute MMA is Utah’s premiere Judo gym. If you want to take Judo classes near Salt Lake City, our professors teach the discipline; and are well qualified to do so. Owner and instructor, Sensei Rob Handley, is a 2nd degree a blackbelt in Judo and a three-time national medalist in the US Judo Nationals. There’s nobody better than to teach you the pure techniques and remarkable discipline of Judo. Absolute MMA teaches from the foundation of the art itself, making us unique from other gyms. Judo is a Japanese martial art that evolved into a combat system and Olympic sport. Participants, called Judoka, combine throws, trips, pins and submissions to beat their opponents.
